text.name: End of the Soviet Union
text.rules: Record "red flag lowered". LIO spends 2 points. SAE chooses: Hold the new states in a commonwealth? If yes, SAE spends 1 point, then until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 less, never below 1; if no, at the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: The Soviet Union recognised the independence of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania on 6 September 1991. On 8 December the leaders of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus agreed to dissolve the Union and found the Commonwealth of Independent States; the Soviet president resigned on 25 December 1991 and the Union ended the next day.
